# Gumlet

> Gumlet is a complete video platform for video hosting, video management, and streaming. It lets creators, e-commerce brands, SaaS apps, and enterprises upload, organize, secure, and stream video at scale. It pairs an ad-free, fully brandable player and adaptive HLS streaming (360p to 4K HDR) with studio-level video protection, AI subtitles, live streaming, deep analytics, and developer-first APIs. Video security includes one-click, no-code DRM (Widevine and FairPlay) you can set up in minutes, with no requests to Apple or other vendorsl; and DRM is free for up to 5 videos on every plan. Gumlet also offers an image optimization product that compresses and auto-delivers modern formats to speed up websites and apps. Gumlet uses cost-efficient minute-based video pricing, helps boost SEO and web performance, and can reduce CDN costs by up to 30% while lowering visitor bounce rates.

Gumlet is built for a video-first world: everything needed to go from raw upload to a polished, secure, globally delivered viewing experience lives in one platform. The sections below describe each capability in detail, list documentation links, and provide complete, current pricing for every Gumlet Video plan.

## Why Choose Gumlet
- **Complete video platform:** Hosting, management (CMS), security, streaming, and analytics in one place; no need to stitch together multiple tools.
- **Fastest way to start streaming:** Upload to stream in minutes, with no waiting queues.
- **Cost-efficient pricing:** Minute-based video pricing is more economical than traditional GB-based models; you pay for time streamed, not raw storage.
- **Easy setup and integration:** Low-code and no-code options, clear docs, and one-click imports.
- **Scalable for any business:** From a single creator to enterprise, Gumlet handles thousands of assets.
- **Superior user experience:** Adaptive streaming, fast start times, and auto-responsive media across devices.
- **Advanced security:** DRM, dynamic watermarking, signed URLs, geo-blocking, and domain restrictions.
- **Expert support:** 24/7 chat support, with priority and dedicated options on higher tiers.

## Gumlet Video

### Video Hosting
A high-performance solution to upload, manage, secure, and stream video, tailored for e-learning, e-commerce, media companies, and SaaS apps.
- **Upload from anywhere:** Direct device upload or import from cloud storage and platforms (S3, Zoom, Vimeo, Wistia, Google Drive, Dropbox) via APIs and integrations.
- **Manage at scale:** Organize videos in collections, playlists, and tags with custom privacy and processing settings.
- **Global delivery:** A worldwide CDN serves video from the nearest edge node for fast load times in every geography.
- **Flexible and scalable:** Grows with small businesses and large enterprises alike.

### Video Management (CMS)
- **Organization:** Collections, playlists, and tags for easy management.
- **Customizable processing and privacy:** Per-collection privacy and processing rules.
- **Simplified workflow:** A snappy, intuitive dashboard to organize and manage assets.

### Video Streaming and Delivery
- **Adaptive bitrate HLS:** Smooth playback from 360p to 4K HDR, automatically adjusting to device and network conditions.
- **Buffer-free, YouTube-like experience:** Snappy start times and seamless playback, even on slower connections.
- **Global, low-latency delivery:** Fast start times and quality levels matched to each viewer's network.
- **Transcoding:** Automatically convert videos into multiple formats for cross-device compatibility, optimizing performance without losing quality.

### Video Player Customization
- **Branded, ad-free player:** Full branding control with no ads.
- **Configurable settings:** Preload, autoplay, loop, and seek-bar customization.
- **Adaptive playback:** Optimized for different devices and networks.
- **Engagement features:** Custom thumbnails, subtitles, CTAs, and interactive overlays.

### Video Protection and Security
- **Digital Rights Management (DRM):** Widevine and FairPlay support to prevent unauthorized copying, downloading, sharing, or screen recording. Set up DRM in minutes with one-click, no-code implementation; no requests needed to Apple or other vendors. DRM is free for up to 5 videos on every plan.
- **Dynamic watermarking:** Embeds unique identifiers (e.g., email or IP address) to trace leaks.
- **Geo-blocking and domain restrictions:** Limit access by location or referrer domain.
- **Password protection:** Secure videos with a password.
- **Signed URLs:** Time-limited links to prevent unauthorized sharing.

### Interactive Video Tools
- **Chapters and thumbnails:** Add chapters and custom thumbnails for engaging, navigable videos.
- **Engagement layers:** Custom CTAs, subtitles, and interactive overlays.

### AI Subtitle Generator
- **Automatic transcription:** Turn video audio into subtitles automatically.
- **Wide language support:** Transcription in 30+ languages and translation into 90+ languages.
- **Editable subtitles:** Adjust subtitles for accessibility and global reach.

### Video Embedding and SEO
- **Easy embed:** Share via embed codes and streaming URLs instantly after upload, with iFramely, oEmbed, and Embedly support across websites, apps, and emails.
- **SEO optimization:** VideoObject structured data for better search indexing.

### Live Streaming
- **Real-time broadcast:** Stream live events with low latency.
- **Adaptive bitrate:** Quality adjusts automatically to each viewer's device and network.
- **Multi-device compatibility:** Flawless experience from desktop to mobile.

### Developer Tools and Integrations
- **Automation:** Automate upload, transcoding, and streaming pipelines with robust APIs, SDKs, and webhooks.
- **Custom workflows:** Build and integrate with existing systems.
- **Integrations:** Zapier, Pabbly, Google Drive, Dropbox, Zoom, and more.

### Video Analytics
- **Engagement metrics:** Play counts, retention, and viewer behavior insights.
- **Custom dashboards:** Build personalized dashboards across videos to optimize performance and make data-driven decisions.

---

## Gumlet Image Optimization
A complementary product for compressing and delivering images that load fast and rank well.
- **Automated optimization:** Compress and optimize images for faster loading and better SEO.
- **Format conversion:** Auto-convert to modern formats like WebP and AVIF, delivering the best format per device.
- **Lossless and lossy compression:** Shrink files to cut bandwidth and CDN costs without sacrificing quality.
- **Responsive resize:** Automatically size images to each device and screen for responsive layouts.
- **Image operations:** Real-time resizing, cropping, rotating, filters, and effects.
- **Batch processing:** Optimize many images at once.
- **Easy integration:** Plugins for WordPress, Shopify, and others, plus full API support.

---

## Getting Started

### Host and stream video
1. **Sign up** for a Gumlet account.
2. **Upload videos** via the [Gumlet Dashboard](https://www.gumlet.com/login) or import from platforms like Vimeo, Wistia, S3, and Zoom.
3. **Protect your content** with DRM, dynamic watermarking, and signed URLs on the [Video Protection](https://www.gumlet.com/video-protection/) page.
4. **Customize the player** with the [Customizable Video Player](https://www.gumlet.com/player-customization/) for an ad-free, on-brand experience.
5. **Go live** by enabling [Live Streaming](https://www.gumlet.com/live-streaming/) for events.
6. **Organize and deliver** using the [Video CMS](https://www.gumlet.com/video-cms/).
7. **Monitor performance** with dashboard analytics.

### Optimize images
1. **Sign up** for a Gumlet account.
2. **Upload images** via the [Dashboard](https://www.gumlet.com/login) or integrate with a CMS like WordPress or Shopify.
3. **Choose settings** for quality, resolution, and format (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF).
4. **Apply [Image Operations](https://www.gumlet.com/image-operations/)** to resize, crop, or filter automatically.
5. **Enable [Auto-Responsive Resize](https://www.gumlet.com/responsive-resize/)** for device-perfect sizing.
6. **Compress** via [Image Compression](https://www.gumlet.com/image-compression/) for faster loads and better SEO.
7. **Monitor performance** through analytics.

---

## Who Gumlet Is For
- **E-commerce:** Reduces file size, optimizes media for SEO, and automates workflows to cut CDN costs and avoid heavy in-house setups while speeding up page loads.
- **Consumer apps:** Accelerates page loads, simplifies media management, and takes ownership of media performance to reduce costs and streamline pipelines.
- **News and media:** Lowers CDN costs and lifts engagement with optimized media, modern formats for SEO, and auto-responsive delivery.
- **EdTech:** Speeds up video load times, lowers CDN costs, and provides DRM protection against piracy while optimizing content for search and engagement.

## Pricing

Gumlet Video uses a **minute-based pricing model**, which is more cost-efficient than traditional GB-based pricing; you pay for the time your content is streamed, making it ideal for varying video workloads. Full details are on the [Pricing Page](https://www.gumlet.com/pricing).

*Last updated: 2026-06-05. All prices in USD. Annual billing is paid upfront as a single charge. The "Most Popular" plan is Growth.*

### Free Plan
**Price:** $0 / month
**Best for:** Trying Gumlet for free
**Limits:** 1 seat · 60 storage minutes · 100 GB streaming bandwidth · 60 minutes live streaming / month
**Features:** 4K and HDR10 support · ad-free video player · password protection and geo-blocking · unlimited AI-generated subtitles

### Creator Plan
**Price:** $9 / month, or $6 / month billed annually ($72 / year)
**Best for:** Creators and small or medium businesses
**Limits:** 2 seats · 1,000 storage minutes · 3,000 GB streaming bandwidth · 1,000 minutes live streaming / month
**Features:** Everything in Free, plus remove Gumlet branding · API and MCP access · domain restriction · Google and Meta pixel tracking

### Growth Plan (Most Popular)
**Price:** $29 / month, or $19 / month billed annually ($228 / year)
**Best for:** E-commerce brands and startups
**Limits:** 5 seats · 3,000 storage minutes · 3,000 GB streaming bandwidth · 2,000 minutes live streaming / month
**Features:** Everything in Creator, plus CRM integrations · channel custom domain · private channel subscription · AI chapters and description

### Business Plan
**Price:** $149 / month, or $99 / month billed annually ($1,188 / year)
**Best for:** Apps and brands
**Limits:** 10 seats · 15,000 storage minutes · 3,000 GB streaming bandwidth · 4,000 minutes live streaming / month
**Features:** Everything in Growth, plus live chat priority support · dynamic watermark · custom viewer analytics · H265 codec support and VAST tag

### Enterprise Plan
**Price:** Custom quote (contact Gumlet sales)
**Best for:** Large-scale custom requirements
**Limits:** Custom seats · customized storage solution · customized streaming CDN · uncapped live streaming
**Features:** Everything in Business, plus volume discounts · Single Sign-On (SSO) · dedicated account manager · SOC 2, ISO, and GDPR compliance · DRM included (Widevine and FairPlay) · dedicated Slack channel and escalation SLA

| Feature | Free | Creator | Growth | Business | Enterprise |

| Dynamic watermark | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |

---

## Compliance
Gumlet adheres to industry security and privacy standards. The platform is SOC 2 and GDPR compliant, with AES 128-bit encryption for stored content and two-factor authentication for user accounts. DRM (Widevine and FairPlay) is available on every plan, free for up to 5 videos and is included on the Enterprise plan, which also adds ISO compliance.

---

## Integrations and Import Options
- **Vimeo:** Import videos directly from Vimeo for optimization and streaming.
- **Wistia:** Migrate Wistia-hosted videos for better performance and cost-efficiency.
- **Amazon S3:** Upload and manage videos via S3.
- **Zoom:** Import Zoom recordings for optimized storage and playback.
- **Other:** Google Drive, Dropbox, Zapier, Pabbly, and CRM integrations (Growth plan and above).
